title: Memorial shelf for ArcanaObscura (Disembarking, pressure door scene)
dedication: In memory of ArcanaObscura. Fly peacefully into the night.
placement: scripts/author-shuttle-scenes.mjs (MEMORIAL_ICON and the memorial block), where the boarding checklist hung

source.what: The server emoji :mikmoff:, added by the community to remember her
source.suppliedBy: The owner, 24 October 2026, who asked for the icon to be pulled and used

derivation: Cropped to the drawn 20x18 pixels; box-sampled to 15x14; each pixel the nearest Activity scene palette colour; made symmetric from its left half like the emoji, her flower kept on the right; pairs of pixel rows drawn as 15 by 7 cells, a half block where one half is empty, otherwise the whole cell in the colour that covers more of that area in the original. No model or image tool.

provenance.author: Arranged by the coding agent (Claude) at owner direction

design: A brass plaque with her icon over the dedication, a blue medical cross whose foot replaces the middle glyph of the top bezel, and a candle on each side (owner review, 24 October 2026).
